hud.canvasDescription: Explore five floors with the Screen Rover. Use WASD or arrow keys to drive (hold Shift to boost). Hover a glowing object (a door, the elevator pad, a board) to see its name and click it to drive there. Drag, use Q and E or the rotate buttons to turn the view all the way around, and R and F to tilt it; press 0 to reset it. Scroll, pinch or press + and - to zoom; zoom all the way in to see through the rover's eyes, where WASD drives where you look, and zoom out to return. The view turns toward displays as you approach. Rotate it yourself to override. Use the elevator, its call pads or PageUp and PageDown to change floors. Classic site shows the portfolio as a regular website.

ask.asOf: Rover's AI answer from this site, as of {date}
ask.privacy: Questions and answers are processed by Cloudflare Workers AI, or by Groq (zero data retention) as a backup when Workers AI is unavailable or out of quota. AI Gateway logs are kept for up to 7 days. Recognized email addresses, phone numbers and ID numbers are masked in questions before AI processing or logging. Questions it cannot answer are kept privately for up to 3 months, masked the same way, so missing topics can be added; only their number and topic are published. This tab keeps the conversation for the browser session. Up to three earlier exchanges may accompany a follow-up. Closing chat hides it. New chat clears this tab's conversation, not retained service logs. No account is needed. Ask AI uses a 30-minute anti-bot cookie, separate from anonymous visit analytics. Please avoid sharing personal information.
